children: Goldman Sachs said it still maintains its forecast for gold at $5,400 per ounce by the end of 2027, despite the Federal Reserve's rate hike yesterday. According to Sina Finance, the bank said continued reserve diversification by central banks remains the main structural driver behind its bullish view on gold.

Goldman Sachs said it expects net upside risks to gold prices to remain, while two-way volatility will also increase along the way. It said gold may first fall to a recent low of $4,070 per ounce before gradually recovering to reach $4,200 per ounce by the end of 2026.

title: PRECIOUS METALS | Goldman Sachs Maintains $5,400 Gold Forecast for End-2027
